Title: Azure Data Factory—Mapping Data Flows is now generally available

Body.Content:
Mapping Data Flows is now generally available. This new capability brings code-free visual data transformation to Azure Data Factory without the need to build transformation logic in external execution engines using custom code. Mapping Data Flows uses a Spark-based scale-out serverless model that’s cost-efficient and scales with your business.

 

To learn how to build big data transformations in Azure Data Factory with Mapping Data Flows, see this collection of videos, tutorials, labs, and guides.
